title: Synopsis: Case Processing Operations Center 2.0
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE COUNTERINTELLIGENCE AND SECURITY AGENCY (DCSA).DEFENSE CI AND SECURITY AGENCY
detail_text: This is a pre-solicitation notice for a non-commercial acquisition using FAR part 15. THIS PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP). VENDORS SHALL NOT SUBMIT FORMAL PROPOSALS UNTIL THE RFP IS POSTED TO THIS WEBSITE. This synopsis is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government nor shall the Government pay for information resulting from this posting. The Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA), 27130 Telegraph Rd, Quantico, VA 22134, has an ongoing requirement for requisite Case Processing Operation Center (CPOC) 2.0 services related to Federal background investigations. Please carefully review the attachment as it contains critical information pertaining to the upcoming solicitation for this requirement.
